title: 第5章 老狐狸
novel_title: 开局暴打渣男，我带九个道侣飞升
content_zh:
“主人，你怎么了？是不是功法出了岔子？还是哪里不舒服？”墨燃看见她额间布满了一层细密汗珠，紧张地询问。

    那些画面过于真实，路仙瑶根本抑制不住自己，她死死抓住墨燃的手臂，声音带着颤抖，“墨燃，你刚才有没有感觉到什么？或者看到什么……特别的画面？”

    “没有啊，主人！我刚才只觉得识海很温暖，很舒服，灵力运转特别顺畅，感觉修为真的在涨呢！”墨燃的脸上只有对修为精进的欣喜，清澈的眸底是一如既往的天真烂漫。

    路仙瑶心一沉。

    只有她看到吗？

    可是她为什么会看到那样的画面呢？

    那究竟是什么？

    是未来即将发生的事情吗？

    心中诸多疑问不得解，她只能暂时压下翻涌的情绪，不让墨燃看出端倪，“没事了。”

    “主人，我想问一个问题。”既然双修结束了，墨燃趁着现下只有他们二人，想问心底压了许久的好奇。

    “问吧。”

    “主人，我从凡间的话本里看到，说有情人之间，翻云覆雨共赴巫山，昨天你和云公子……”

    “没有！”

    路仙瑶没有想到他会问这么惊天的问题，连忙否认，并数落他，“你怎么会想到问这样的问题？”

    “我昨天看见你和云公子……”

    “我说没有！”路仙瑶不给他说后半句的机会。

    “为什么呀？你不是喜欢云公子吗？”墨燃歪着个脑袋，眼神单纯无辜。

    “那是以前，现在不喜欢了。”路仙瑶义正言辞地给自己洗白，想到他昨天散播谣言，又数落他，“还有，有些事情不一定眼见为实，你若再敢散播我的谣言，我定惩不饶！”

    “是……”墨燃想个做错事的孩子低头。
content_en:
"Master, what's wrong with you? Is there something wrong with the technique? Or do you feel uncomfortable somewhere?" Mo Ran asked nervously when he saw a layer of fine beads of sweat covering her forehead.

    Those pictures were so real that Lu Xianyao couldn't restrain herself at all. She grabbed Mo Ran's arm tightly, her voice trembling, "Mo Ran, did you feel anything just now? Or saw something... special?"

    "No, Master! I just felt that the sea of consciousness was very warm and comfortable, and my spiritual power was running particularly smoothly. I felt that my cultivation level was really rising!" The ink-burning face was filled with joy at the advancement of cultivation, and his clear eyes were as innocent as ever.

    Lu Xianyao's heart sank.

    Was she the only one who saw it?

    But why did she see such a scene?

    What exactly is that?

    Is it something that is about to happen in the future?

    There were many unanswered questions in her heart. She could only temporarily suppress the surging emotions to prevent Mo Ran from seeing the clues. "It's okay."

    "Master, I want to ask a question." Now that the dual cultivation is over, Mo Ran takes advantage of the fact that there are only two of them now, and wants to ask the curiosity that has been suppressed in his heart for a long time.

    "Ask."

    "Master, I read it in a mortal book, saying that lovers go to Wushan together through thick and thin. Yesterday you and Mr. Yun..."

    "No!"

    Lu Xianyao did not expect that he would ask such a shocking question, so she quickly denied it and scolded him, "How could you think of asking such a question?"

    "I saw you and Mr. Yun yesterday..."

    "I said no!" Lu Xianyao didn't give him a chance to say the second half of the sentence.

    "Why? Don't you like Mr. Yun?" Mo Ran tilted his head, his eyes pure and innocent.

    "That was before, but I don't like it now." Lu Xianyao defended herself righteously. Thinking of him spreading rumors yesterday, she scolded him again, "Also, some things may not be believed until they are seen. If you dare to spread rumors about me again, I will punish you without mercy!"

    "Yes..." Mo Ran thought of a child who had done something wrong and lowered his head.
